# bookmatch — quality and operations for the in-place deployed recommendation service

> [!warning] A failed deploy rolls back to the last known-good revision, but a rollback is impossible when no last-good revision is recorded — `deploy.sh` logs the error and exits non-zero.

Current health: `deploy.sh` considers a deploy healthy only when `/api/health` reports `ok` AND `corpus_ready`.

## Behavioral contracts

- **deploy is never silent** — `deploy.sh` aborts non-zero on a missing sudo ticket, a failed restart, or a dead `/api/health` (deploy.sh:19, deploy.sh:35).
- **a failed deploy rolls back** — the script restarts the unit from the last known-good revision; if no last-good revision exists, it logs an error and exits non-zero (deploy.sh:42).
- **health is proven after every deploy** — `deploy.sh` polls `/api/health` for up to 20 seconds, requiring both `ok` and `corpus_ready` flags (deploy.sh:19).
- **pushes never bypass the test gate** — `scripts/install_hooks.sh` sets `core.hooksPath` to `.githooks`; a fresh clone that skips this silently bypasses the ADR-0020 test gate (scripts/install_hooks.sh:4).
- **the index is always rebuilt from scratch** — `build_index.py` is idempotent and rewrites the index directory each run (scripts/build_index.py:16).

## Health

- The aliveness signal is `/api/health`, polled by `deploy.sh` for up to 20 seconds.
- `ok` is false when the service is not running or the endpoint is unreachable.
- `corpus_ready` is false when the neighbor-gap index is missing or incomplete.
- A FAILURE looks like a non-zero exit from `deploy.sh` with a rollback attempt.
- QUIET looks like no requests — the service may be healthy with zero traffic; do not conflate "no activity" with "broken".

## Policies & SLAs

| name | value | source config |
|---|---|---|
| health poll timeout | 20 seconds | `deploy.sh` |
| health required flags | `ok` AND `corpus_ready` | `deploy.sh` |
| index build chunk size | 20 million rows | `scripts/build_index.py` |
| index build batch size | 50,000 | `scripts/build_index.py` |
| download timeout per file | 2 hours | `scripts/download_dataset.sh` |

## Tests

- The test suite runs via pytest on push/PR (`.github/workflows/tests.yml`) and via the pre-push hook locally.
- The suite does not cover the deploy path — `deploy.sh` is a shell script exercised manually on aurora.

## Deploy & operate

- Ship path: push to `main` → pre-push hook runs the test suite → `deploy.sh` restarts the unit.
- `deploy.sh` refuses to deploy unless on the `main` branch with a clean tree and `HEAD` matches `origin/main` (deploy.sh:10, deploy.sh:13).
- Restart command: `sudo -n systemctl restart bookmatch.service` via `deploy.sh` (deploy.sh:35).
- Rollback: `deploy.sh` rolls back to the last known-good revision if health checks fail, but still exits 1 (deploy.sh:42).

## Secrets handling

- The env keys are `BASE`, `BOOKMATCH_INDEX`, `BOOKMATCH_RAW`, `BRANCH`, `DEST`, `FILES`, `LAST_GOOD_FILE`, `PREV`, `TARGET`.
